paragraphs: ACTIVE.com is a consumer website where people search for and register online for races, events, team sports and recreational activities. Its directory covers more than 290,000 races, leagues, tournaments, camps and other recreational listings across more than 80 sports and 5,000 cities. Organizers who want an event listed are asked to get in touch with the site directly.

Alongside registration, the site publishes training plans, tips and articles covering running, triathlon, cycling, nutrition and other activities. It states that the product reviews it features are written by subject experts. A paid membership called ACTIVE Advantage gives individuals discounts on gear and on event registration fees.

The site says more than 8 million people receive its weekly and monthly newsletters. ACTIVE.com is part of Active Network, LLC. That parent company supplies application services technology and marketing to community service and participatory sports organizations.

quote.text: ACTIVE.com hosts the world's largest directory of sports and recreational activities, facilities, venues and classes
